categories.main_business_segments: COSCO SHIPPING Energy Transportation Co., Ltd. primarily operates in oil shipping and liquefied natural gas (LNG) transportation, with additional businesses in liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) and chemical transportation. The company provides comprehensive energy shipping services including vessel chartering and integrated logistics solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced maritime technologies for the transportation of oil, LNG, LPG, and chemicals, including specialized vessels such as Very Large Crude Carriers (VLCCs), LNG carriers with high insulation and safety standards, and chemical tankers classified by hazard levels. It emphasizes world-class safety management systems, technical upgrades, and green transformation initiatives including biofuel pilot applications and dual-fuel vessel designs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: COSCO SHIPPING Energy serves major oil companies, strategic partners, domestic and international refineries, and energy traders. Its customer base includes large-scale oil and gas importers, LNG project operators, and chemical producers, targeting global energy transportation markets with a focus on China’s substantial oil and gas import demand.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a strong presence in China’s domestic market and international routes including the Atlantic, Middle East, West Africa, Europe, Oceania, and the Far East. It maintains a global marketing and emergency support system with satellite offices to expand overseas market share.
categories.supply_chain_position: COSCO SHIPPING Energy operates primarily in the midstream segment of the energy supply chain, providing maritime transportation services for crude oil, LNG, LPG, and chemicals. It acts as a key logistics provider connecting energy producers and consumers worldwide.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on fleet expansion, digital transformation, green and low-carbon shipping technologies, and enhancing LNG full-chain capabilities. It invests in technological innovation such as intelligent ship technologies, big data, AI applications, and carbon footprint management to drive sustainable development and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through freight charges from shipping services, including spot market chartering, time chartering, contracts of affreightment (COA), and participation in operating pools. The company also earns income from vessel chartering and integrated logistics services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: COSCO SHIPPING Energy is a global leader and the world’s largest oil tanker owner with a comprehensive fleet covering all mainstream tanker types. It is a leading player in China’s LNG transportation market and holds significant market influence and brand reputation internationally, competing with other major global shipping and energy transportation companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenues of RMB 23.13 billion in 2024, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 4.04 billion, marking steady growth and the best performance since its 2016 merger. It operates a large fleet of 159 oil tankers, 87 LNG carriers, 11 LPG carriers, and 8 chemical tankers, with ongoing fleet expansion projects and capital commitments exceeding RMB 17 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: COSCO SHIPPING Energy offers comprehensive, whole-process energy transportation solutions with a diverse and large fleet enabling flexible and efficient logistics. It emphasizes safety, environmental sustainability, technological innovation, and integrated supply chain services to provide reliable, cost-effective, and value-added shipping solutions tailored to global energy customers.
